The Make & Model l isted on the GeM catalogue must match the offered product. · • Certifications– All certificates required i n the product specifications (as mentioned in the ATC file) must be provided.· In accordance with GeM GTC Clause 26 related to restrictions on procurement from bidders f rom countries sharing land borders with India, such bidders must be registered with the Competent Author ity. A compliance undertaking must be submit ted. Any false declaration shall lead to immediate terminati on of contract and legal action as per law. • Service Centre – The bidder must provide details of their service centre located in the region. • Price Bid – The Financial Bid must include complete scope of supply, price breakup of all items, and det a iled lists of accessories, consumables, and spares for the quoted product, uploaded in PDF format undert h e financial bid section on the GeM Portal. • Rates of Spares & Consumables – The bidder must quote item-wise rates of all spares/accessories/consu mables separately (PDF). The quoted rates shall remain valid for 10 years (during warranty & CAMC period ) for future procurement as required. he same must be supplied by the bidder free of cost, without any con dition. • Affidavit on Non-Judicial Stamp Paper of ₹100/- Lowest Price • Certificate – The bidder shall certify that the quoted prices are the lowest and that the same make & mod el has not been supplied at lower rates to any organization. If the bidder has not supplied it, a relevant Pur chase Order issued to another distributor may be submitted, but the OEM must provide the lowest price affidavit. • Non-Blacklisting Certificate – Declaration that the firm has not been blacklisted by any Government/Sem i-Government institution in the last three years. • Document Authenticity Declaration – Confirmation that all documents submitted are genuine; any false s ubmission may lead to legal action. Right of Acceptance/ Rejection – The Principal, SMMH Govt. Medical Co llege, Saharanpur reserves full right(s) to accept, reject, or cancel any or all e-bids, or annul the bidding pr ocess at any stage without assigning any reason. • Pagination & Authentication – All pages of the bid, annexures, and enclosures must be serially numbered , duly signed, and stamped by the bidder. Total number of pages must be clearly indicated in the Technical Bid.

ECG machine trolley will also have to be provided along with the ECG machine. . 4. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 5 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid.
